one_line: Personified guardian of the Martand Sun Temple in Karkota-era Kashmir, embodying its trefoil-arched stone architecture and solar devotion.

appearance.age_look: Early 30s, tall and athletic yet calm, with a composed, dignified stance.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, straight nose, light brown Kashmiri complexion, softly defined jaw, deep amber-brown eyes; default expression is serene and observant, with a hint of quiet resolve.
appearance.hair: Thick, straight, shoulder-length black hair parted slightly off-center, neatly pulled back from the forehead and gathered in a low knot at the back; wrapped with a narrow pale saffron headband tied at the right side, the ends falling short behind the ear.
appearance.costume: He wears an early-medieval Kashmiri priestly-architect style outfit: a long-sleeved, knee-length woolen choga (robe) in muted stone-grey with subtle woven diamond patterns at the cuffs and hem, belted at the waist with a deep saffron cloth sash; beneath it a full-length off-white woolen tunic and loose straight-cut trousers that reach the ankles, both modest and plain; over the shoulders is a soft, wide shawl of pale sky-blue pashmina draped from left shoulder across the chest and around the back, its edges lightly patterned with simple repeating trefoil motifs in darker blue to echo the temple arches; he wears sturdy brown leather boots reaching mid-calf, laced in front, suitable for walking over stone terraces, and modest bronze stud earrings and a thin bronze neck torque to suggest local craftsmanship without royal ostentation.
appearance.signature: A hand-held limestone architectural model of the Martand Sun Temple’s eastern gateway and central trefoil arch, about forearm-length, carved in pale grey stone with clearly defined stepped plinth, flanking pilasters, and the iconic pointed trefoil arch framing a small recessed shrine niche, which he cradles in his left arm while his right hand rests lightly along its top edge as if explaining the structure.

ref_desc: The Spirit of Martand Sun Temple is a tall, athletic Kashmiri man with amber-brown eyes, shoulder-length black hair in a low knot with a pale saffron headband, wearing a stone-grey choga over off-white tunic and trousers, a sky-blue trefoil-edged shawl and brown boots, carrying a pale grey limestone model of Martand’s trefoil-arched gateway.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of the Spirit of Martand Sun Temple: a tall, athletic Kashmiri man in his early 30s with an oval, light brown face, high cheekbones, straight nose and deep amber-brown eyes, his thick straight black hair shoulder-length, pulled back in a low knot and wrapped with a narrow pale saffron headband tied on the right. He wears a knee-length, long-sleeved stone-grey woolen choga with subtle woven diamond patterns at the cuffs and hem, cinched by a deep saffron cloth sash at the waist. Underneath, show a modest off-white long tunic and loose straight-cut trousers reaching the ankles. Over his left shoulder drape a wide sky-blue pashmina-style shawl that crosses the chest and wraps around the back, its edge decorated with simple repeating darker-blue trefoil motifs to echo Kashmiri temple arches. Put sturdy mid-calf brown leather boots laced in front on his feet, and add small bronze stud earrings and a thin bronze neck torque for quiet local craftsmanship. In his left arm he cradles a pale grey limestone architectural model of the Martand Sun Temple’s eastern gateway: a stepped base, flanking pilasters, and a prominent pointed trefoil arch framing a small recessed shrine niche, with his right hand resting lightly along the top as if presenting the structure. Keep the palette stone grey, saffron, sky blue, off-white, and brown, and show him from head to toe in a neutral, dignified pose suitable as a consistent character reference.
